changelog:
Initial release of markdown-to-image.

- Converts Markdown into shareable image cards with professional formatting for social platforms.
- Includes mandatory pre-check for file issues (content, technical, formatting) before image generation.
- Generates a cover card with a short, book-style title automatically created from document content.
- All options have sensible defaults; no user prompts unless issues are detected.
- Outputs images directly to the Downloads folder, organized by card title.
summary: Use when user wants to convert Markdown content into shareable image cards — triggered by phrases like "转图片"、"做卡片"、"生成海报"、"生成分享图"、"把这个转成图片"、"export as image"...
